test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 05 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.**

After seeing that Shreya / was in trouble, / Rahul quietly stepped up to help.

options.text: Rahul quietly stepped up to help

solution:
The correct answer is: **No error** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• If we want to use a verb after a preposition, it must be in -ing form. It is impossible to use an infinitive a
